name: Daytona
description: Agent sandboxes with independent kernel per sandbox and sub-90ms snapshot resume.
descriptionZh: 每个沙箱拥有独立内核、快照恢复冷启动低于 90ms 的 Agent 沙箱。
keyFact: Daytona is an AGPL-3.0 sandbox platform where each sandbox gets its own kernel, filesystem and network stack, with snapshot-based resume in under 90ms; it is OCI/Docker-compatible with SDKs for Python, TypeScript, Ruby, Go and Java, and the project has disclosed CVEs including a path-traversal issue (GO-2026-5367) and a cross-tenant data exposure.
keyFactZh: Daytona 是 AGPL-3.0 的沙箱平台，每个沙箱拥有独立内核、文件系统与网络栈，基于快照的恢复冷启动低于 90ms；它兼容 OCI/Docker，提供 Python、TypeScript、Ruby、Go、Java SDK，且官方披露过多个 CVE（含路径穿越 GO-2026-5367 与跨租户数据泄露）。
caveat: AGPL-3.0 has strong copyleft implications for hosted derivatives; the project has publicly disclosed several security CVEs.
caveatZh: AGPL-3.0 对托管衍生服务有较强的 copyleft 约束；项目曾公开披露多个安全 CVE。
